purpose: Measure the incremental information in an independent historical OU2.5 market for Direct-T and natural draw probabilities on a pre-frozen 300-match sample.

training.direct_t_model: StandardScaler + sklearn LogisticRegression L2, C=1.0, solver=lbfgs, max_iter=5000, tol=1e-8; no class_weight

conditional_draw.T=2,4,6,7+: separate StandardScaler + LogisticRegression L2 with the same features; C=1.0, solver=lbfgs, max_iter=5000, tol=1e-8; target is match draw conditional on total category

training.home_away_residual: after structural draw mass, split 1-pD in proportion to target grid71 qH:qA

target_market_features.construction: for each bookmaker with a complete H/D/A triple, convert to inverse odds; average implied probabilities by outcome then normalize across H/D/A

ou_projection.type: two-group KL/I-projection preserving within-group prior ratios

uncertainty: 2000 iid bootstrap resamples with fixed seed 20260814; report 90% interval for Direct-T LL and HDA LL deltas
hard_prohibitions: no formal promotion from this retrospective sample
decision_rule: OU is a positive R55 increment only if Direct-T LogLoss improves and HDA/Draw proper scores do not materially worsen; natural Top-1 draw behavior is reported but is not optimized.
